title: Serve hierarchical folder operations
acceptance:
Story: members organise work in folders rather than one flat list.
Expected: create a folder, list any folder, read, write and delete files and empty folders by relative path, with parent checks and the 64 KiB text limit kept.
Not expected: move or rename, binary or multipart uploads, or any sharing between members.
Depends on: WI-13 sessions; WI-17 proves its boundaries.
Verify: acceptance builds a nested tree, reads it back and deletes parts of it.
evidence: POST /folder and GET, PUT and DELETE on /files paths create, list, read, write and remove files and empty folders by relative path; the 64 KiB limit answers 413 (node test). The 26 November review found empty folders could not be deleted; WI-23 uses rmdir, returns 200 for an empty folder and keeps 409 for a non-empty one, and verify.py deletes an empty folder through the launcher. Increment PR #6 (merged): https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6; review fixes and tooling in PR #7: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/7.
